# edh-zones-10 (Commander effort, lane edh-zones; test/cloud/edh-zones-10, golden edh-zones-10-review.json): tutor to top with a mana value, shuffle the rest into the library, search for any number with total mana value, search for N cards, any number of lands onto the battlefield under your control, repeat this process until, shares a permanent type, "if it's a nonland card"
